KEY SECTORS: RETAIL AND SERVICES
Praça da Fruta · Pedro Ribeiro Simões · CC BY 2.0
People in the streets. Praça da Fruta has opened 
every day since the 15th century, and in 2026 the 
town is Europe’s Capital of Small Retail.
HIGHLIGHTS
■ A  town-wide  programme  behind  its  shops:  digital 
Commercial District (smart lockers, footfall sensors, multilingual  
marketplace  and  app),  Green  Shop,  Caldas  Lab  Store,  Living 
Retail Council, Caldas Late Night and Heritage Shops[2].
■ Customers arriving: 6,111 more residents since 2021 and 
207,225 tourist nights in 2023[3][4].
■ Capital that believes: the Shoppings Ibéria I fund (Point 
Capital) bought La Vie Caldas da Rainha in 2025[5].
WHERE YOU COULD FIT
■ Brand stores with local products, ceramics and design — «Caldas 
by its makers».
■ Showrooms, signature food and neighbourhood services.

KEY SECTORS: HEALTH AND WELLBEING
Lago do Parque D. Carlos I · Senhormario · CC BY-SA 4.0 (cropped)
The town that was born from a hospital. In 1485, 
Queen Leonor founded the thermal hospital 
considered the oldest in the world[10].
HIGHLIGHTS
■ Training built for the sector: since 6 October, the University of 
Leiria and Oeste Health campus offers Thermalism and Wellbeing; 
Aesthetics,  Cosmetics  and  Wellbeing;  Forensic  Laboratory;  
Healthy Eating[11].
■ Investment on the way: CUF clinic due in Q3 2027[12]; Montebelo 
Bordalo  Hotel  (~€15m,  REVIVE)  announced [13];  a  new  ~€7m  
thermal bathhouse being planned[14].
■ In full transparency: the Thermal Hospital has been temporarily 
closed since summer 2026 for technical works[15].
WHERE YOU COULD FIT
■ Rehabilitation, active ageing and long-term care.
■ Wellness and thermal experiences linked to tourism; digital health 
with higher education.

KEY SECTORS: DEFENCE AND AEROSPACE
TEKEVER AR3 (RAF) · illustrative image, not taken in Caldas · Crown copyright · OGL v3
Engineering that flies. Tekever — a Portuguese 
unicorn headquartered in Lisbon — designs 
around 90% of its AR5 drone in Caldas[16].
HIGHLIGHTS
■ An anchor that is expanding: planning change in Bouro for a 
new factory and test runway; operator training in nearby 
Peniche[17][18].
■ A national cluster gaining scale: drones are now Portugal’s 
leading defence export, in a cluster of over 100 companies[19].
■ Precision manufacturing: Schaeffler (~500 people) and Martin 
Caldeiras; CENFIM and ESAD.CR training[20][21].
WHERE YOU COULD FIT
■ Machining, composites, electronics, wiring, software and testing.
■ Civil and dual-use applications; technical training and 
maintenance.
An anchor does not guarantee contracts; certifications and export controls are 
assessed project by project.
FEATURED STATS
>€1.2bn

KEY SECTORS: AGRI-FOOD
Praça da Fruta · Pedro Ribeiro Simões · CC BY 2.0
At the heart of Portugal’s orchard. The Oeste grows 
almost all of Portugal’s pears and ships them 
worldwide.
HIGHLIGHTS
■ Protected-origin produce: Pera Rocha do Oeste PDO was 
worth €150m in 2024, €85m exported[23]; Maçã de Alcobaça PGI 
adds €60–70m a year[24].
■ A national showcase: Frutos — the National Fruit and 
Vegetable Fair — has been held in Parque D. Carlos I since 
1978[25].
■ Cutting-edge packaging: «Packaging of the Future» agenda 
(79 partners) and LiDA[26].
WHERE YOU COULD FIT
■ Processing: juices, dried fruit, fresh-cut, snacks.
■ Sustainable packaging, cold chain and agri-tech.
Regional (Oeste) figures; municipality-level data on request.

KEY SECTORS: HOUSING
Foz do Arelho · Alexey Komarov · CC BY 4.0
A growing town needs homes. Families, students 
and engineering teams are arriving — and demand 
is still ahead of supply.
HIGHLIGHTS
■ Proven demand: bank valuations +21.5% in 2025, ahead of the 
Oeste (18.2%); 147 new buildings completed[29][3].
■ New audiences: ~1,600 ESAD.CR students, the Health campus 
and Tekever’s expansion[30][11][17].
■ Active public policy: Local Housing Strategy (1.º Direito) and 
state homes for affordable rent[31][32].
WHERE YOU COULD FIT
■ Mid-market development and build-to-rent.
■ Historic-centre regeneration; student residences; senior living.
FEATURED STATS
1,071
homes licensed in 2025 (+30%)[29]
